pipeline.title: Roche’s phase 3 win tees up fight with Novartis for blockbuster kidney disease market
pipeline.summary: Roche has reported a phase 3 win for sefaxersen in kidney disease, teeing up talks with regulators about the path to approval for the Ionis-partnered, would-be blockbuster candidate.

pipeline.title: Amgen reports a Phase 3 win with Sjögren’s drug candidate
pipeline.summary: Dazodalibep, acquired in Amgen’s big buyout of Horizon Therapeutics, succeeded in the first of two late-stage trials against the tough-to-treat autoimmune disorder.

pipeline.title: Celldex monoclonal antibody rebounds with pair of phase 3 wins for chronic skin condition
pipeline.summary: Celldex touted a double phase 3 trial win in patients with treatment-refractory chronic spontaneous urticaria.

pipeline.title: Amgen’s Horizon-acquired fusion protein eases Sjögren's severity in ph. 3 win
pipeline.summary: An investigational drug for the autoimmune condition Sjögren's disease has scored a phase 3 win for Amgen, marking a positive sign for the Horizon Therapeutics-acquired pipeline that has so far struggled to gain traction.

pipeline.title: Vertex’s midstage data amplify kidney disease market opportunity
pipeline.summary: Vertex has reported positive phase 2b data for its kidney disease prospect inaxaplin, boosting its efforts to expand beyond the population targeted in a pivotal trial.

pipeline.title: Otsuka heads to FDA as Ionis-partnered ALS drug hits primary phase 3 endpoint
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 study of Otsuka and Ionis Pharmaceuticals’ amyotrophic lateral sclerosis drug candidate has hit its primary endpoint, positioning the partners to talk to regulators about expedited approvals.

pipeline.title: Cordis’ sirolimus drug-coated balloon earns FDA approval as a breakthrough device
pipeline.summary: The FDA gave the green light to a first and only sirolimus drug-eluting balloon designed by Cordis to treat coronary in-stent restenosis.

pipeline.title: Roche’s GLP-1/GIP drug hits in phase 2 diabetes trial, fueling best-in-disease hopes
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 trial of Roche’s dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist has hit its primary endpoints, painting the drug candidate as a potential treatment for people with type 2 diabetes and overweight or obesity.

pipeline.title: J&J firms up Caplyta's 1st phase 3 win in bipolar-associated manic episodes
pipeline.summary: As Johnson & Johnson’s $14.6 billion bet on Intra-Cellular Therapies continues to pay off with blockbuster sales of Caplyta, the atypical antipsychotic has passed a phase 3 test that puts it one step closer to a broader psychiatric label.

pipeline.title: Cue chalks up phase 2 hives win for Xolair challenger
pipeline.summary: A midstage study of Cue Biopharma’s hives drug candidate has hit its primary endpoint, emboldening the biotech to move the would-be challenger to Xolair into a phase 2b/3 trial.

pipeline.title: Beacon lights path to FDA approval with pivotal trial win for rare vision loss gene therapy
pipeline.summary: Beacon Therapeutics has found the light in a rare vision loss disease that has left larger companies in the dark. The biotech’s gene therapy for X-linked retinitis pigmentosa (XLRP) successfully improved visual acuity in a pivotal trial, setting up the startup to seek regulatory

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly escalates oral SERD battle with FDA approval for Inluriyo, Verzenio combo
pipeline.summary: With longer progression-free survival, Jake Van Naarden, president of Lilly Oncology, told Fierce he expects most patients to choose the combination over oral SERD monotherapy.

pipeline.title: FDA approves Ultragenyx’s gene therapy Fayuvi for rare neurodegenerative disorder
pipeline.summary: Ultragenyx scored a belated regulatory win with FDA approval for a first-in-disease gene therapy, giving the company a boost after a previous regulatory rejection and a recent late-stage setback.

pipeline.title: Changing expectations: How GRAM is strengthening CDMO partnerships
pipeline.summary: How proactive risk management, transparency and flexible communication can turn a CDMO relationship into a true strategic partnership.

pipeline.title: Clinical trials reach a new automation inflection point
pipeline.summary: As trial complexity grows, agentic AI is emerging as a new model for connecting workflows and accelerating execution.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca recommits to youth health to dial funding past $100M
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has re-upped its UNICEF-partnered Young Health Programme, committing to a new five-year phase that will move total investment in the initiative above $100 million.

pipeline.title: 'The growth driver of our organization'; Genentech CMO Zoë Lazarre on experimental marketing, AI and the ‘last mile gap’
pipeline.summary: Genentech's chief marketing officer Zoë Lazarre, Ph.D., likens AI to a “armor, or a digital backpack” that her teams can use for better, faster insights, she said during an interview at Fierce Pharma Week.

pipeline.title: Bristol Myers cuts another 265 jobs tied to New Jersey headquarters
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb plans to lay off another 265 employees tied to its corporate headquarters in New Jersey, bringing the number of total job reductions the company has announced this year in the Garden State to more than 700.

pipeline.title: GSK aiming to ‘balance West and East’ after Hansoh deal success showed China’s potential
pipeline.summary: GSK has been operating a strategy of “balancing the West and the East” since the Big Pharma’s eyes were opened to the potential of licensing drugs from China two years ago, according to an executive.

pipeline.title: Novartis secures new radioligand in $900M deal as competition strengthens
pipeline.summary: As an imposing new competitor begins to take shape, radiopharma leader Novartis has beefed up its pipeline by licensing a preclinical radioligand therapy from a specialist Chinese biotech.

pipeline.title: Viking shares surge on updated obesity drug data
pipeline.summary: Trial participants mostly kept their weight down after switching from a weekly shot to less frequent dosing — findings that could strengthen Viking’s “competitive positioning,” one analyst wrote.

pipeline.title: Celldex sinks as safety concerns cloud immune drug results
pipeline.summary: Though barzolvolimab displayed what one analyst described as the best efficacy results to date against chronic skin hives, treatment was also associated with two life-threatening anaphylaxis cases.

pipeline.title: 'Europe does not value what you do': 9 pharmas make urgent call for bloc to beef up innovation muscle
pipeline.summary: As China and the U.S. presently duke it out over biopharma innovation supremacy, a clutch of Europe’s biggest drugmakers are calling on the bloc to not lose sight of its R&D roots.

pipeline.title: An orexin drug’s ‘proof-of-concept’ in ADHD; Cue’s ‘unwarranted’ share slide
pipeline.summary: Alkermes’ results heightened anticipation for a coming readout in 2027. Elsewhere, AbbVie leaned into AI drug discovery and the FDA expanded use of Eli Lilly’s breast cancer pill.

pipeline.title: Lexeo takes up the Mantle in $8M acquisition for Friedreich ataxia assets
pipeline.summary: Lexeo Therapeutics has agreed to acquire Mantle Therapeutics via an upfront payment of $8.3 million, aiming to expand its Friedreich ataxia (FA) portfolio while locking in three strategic collaborations to support its lead asset.

pipeline.title: Travere CEO Eric Dube to step down after transforming the rare disease biotech
pipeline.summary: Eric Dube, Ph.D., the CEO who rebranded Travere Therapeutics and oversaw the launch of its rare kidney disease drug Filspari, will step down to “focus on his health and family.” Bradley Campbell, formerly CEO of Amicus Therapeutics, will take the reins.

pipeline.title: Siemens Healthineers and Novo team up on fatty liver disease awareness, testing
pipeline.summary: Siemens Healthineers is joining forces with Novo to help boost awareness and diagnosis of fatty liver disease.

pipeline.title: Par Health recalls IV sedative in US, flagging presence of cellulose, stopper material
